## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Lóngshī nǚ jīng* (T557) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra by Zhī Qiān 支謙 ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99)). The protagonist *Lóngshī* 龍施 ("Nāga-Donor"; Sanskrit *Nāgadattā*) is a young nāga-girl who exemplifies female bodhisattva-realization. Cf. [KR6i0190](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0190) (T558, *Lóngshī púsà běn qǐ jīng*) translated by Dharmarakṣa.

**Abstract**

This is one of the "wise women" / female bodhisattva texts, doctrinally close to the Nāga-girl narrative in the *Lotus Sūtra*. Translation dated to Zhī Qiān's Wú productive period (222–252 CE).
